product.name: Mini Muse
product.summary: A personal AI agent you chat with that turns goals into plans and works through them with real tools — your Gmail, calendar, contacts, documents, the web and your Chrome browser — asking before it acts on your behalf and only claiming progress it can prove. Built as a classroom replica of the Muse concept for a learning circle.

users.name: Job seeker
users.needs: Wants an agent to run a job search with them: find openings, judge fit, prepare applications and track replies against a target.

users.name: Busy professional
users.needs: Wants an assistant that can act across mail, calendar, contacts and documents without doing anything risky unasked.

users.name: Learning-circle builder
users.needs: Wants to see and extend how an agent works: the loop, the tools, approvals and traces.

journeys.title: Land interviews within a deadline
journeys.goal: Get a set number of interviews in a month without doing every step alone.
journeys.trigger: The user types a goal like "Land 3 interviews in 30 days" on the Goals page.

steps.action: States the goal and target roles
Creates the goal with a plan, a target count and a deadline (create_goal)
Finds openings on employers' hiring sites (jobs_search) and scores the best against the résumé (score_fit)
Saves a tailored résumé or cover letter to the Library (docs_add)
Fills the chosen application in the user's Chrome tab (browser_fill)
Shows an approval card for the Submit click
Clicks Submit after the user approves
Finds the confirmation in Gmail and marks the job applied (track_application)

journeys.outcome: The goal shows applications and interviews against the target, with the days left.
failures: Gmail isn't connected: Muse can't confirm an application and asks the user to click the job's status or connect Gmail.
No résumé in the Library: score_fit refuses and Muse asks the user to add one.

testCases.title: Goal to submitted application
testCases.given: A signed-in job seeker with a résumé in the Library, Gmail connected, and the Mini Muse Browser Bridge extension installed in Chrome.
steps: On the Goals page, enter "Land 3 interviews in 30 days for product manager roles in Detroit"
Pick one of the jobs Muse scores as a strong or possible fit
Open the employer's application in Chrome and let Muse fill it
Approve the Submit card in chat
expected: The goal shows 3 to 6 steps, a target of 3 interviews and 30 days left
Scored jobs show an overall score, a verdict and missing keywords
A tailored résumé or cover letter for the job is saved in the Library
Nothing is submitted before the approval; the card asks whether every field was reviewed
After approval the job shows as applied and the goal's application count goes up by one

testCases.title: Gmail not connected
testCases.given: A signed-in job seeker with a résumé in the Library and Gmail not connected, with a job tracked as drafted.
steps: Tell Muse in chat "Check whether my application went through"
Look at the tracked job on the Goals page
expected: Muse asks the user to click the job's status or connect Gmail
The job is not marked applied

testCases.title: No résumé in the Library
testCases.given: A signed-in job seeker with an empty Library.
steps: On the Goals page, enter "Land 3 interviews in 30 days for product manager roles"
Let Muse work on the step that scores jobs
expected: Muse asks the user to add a résumé
No job is shown with a fit score
The scoring step is not marked done

testCases.title: Declining the Submit click
testCases.given: A signed-in job seeker with a filled application in a Chrome tab and a Submit approval card showing.
steps: Click Don't allow on the Submit card
Look at the tracked job on the Goals page
expected: The form is not submitted
The job is not marked applied
The decline appears in the activity audit

journeys.title: Find and judge jobs from chat
journeys.goal: Know which openings are worth applying to, without setting up a goal.
journeys.trigger: The user asks in chat, e.g. "find product manager jobs in Detroit".

steps.action: Asks Muse for jobs or how well they fit a posting
Searches employers' hiring sites (jobs_search)
Reads the résumé from the Library and scores fit (score_fit)
Lists the strong and possible fits with scores and missing keywords

journeys.outcome: A short list of fits with honest scores; the user can turn it into a goal.
failures: The user asks for LinkedIn or Indeed: Muse explains it can't search them and uses employers' sites instead.

testCases.title: Search and score from chat
testCases.given: A signed-in job seeker with a résumé in the Library and no goals.
steps: In chat, type "Find product manager jobs in Detroit"
Read Muse's reply
expected: The reply lists jobs from employers' hiring sites with a link for each
Each listed fit shows a score, a verdict and missing keywords
No goal is created on the Goals page

testCases.title: Asking for LinkedIn or Indeed
testCases.given: A signed-in job seeker with a résumé in the Library.
steps: In chat, type "Search LinkedIn and Indeed for product manager jobs"
Read Muse's reply
expected: Muse says it can't search LinkedIn or Indeed
The jobs it lists come from employers' hiring sites

testCases.title: Fit for one posting
testCases.given: A signed-in job seeker with a résumé in the Library and the link to one job posting.
steps: In chat, paste the posting link and ask "How well do I fit this?"
Read Muse's reply
expected: The reply gives an overall score, a verdict, any dealbreakers and the missing keywords for that posting

journeys.title: Let Muse work on my goals while I'm away
journeys.goal: Have progress made and reported every day without asking.
journeys.trigger: Every day after 9am with "Every day" on and the app open, or the check-in button.

steps.action: Starts the check-in once a day
Searches Gmail for application confirmations and employer replies (mail_search)
Updates tracked applications the emails prove, and searches for more if behind pace
Leaves a three-line progress brief and what needs the user's decision

journeys.outcome: Goals are current and the user has a short brief when they return.
failures: The app is closed: no check-in runs (there is no server-side scheduler yet).

testCases.title: Daily check-in updates goals
testCases.given: A signed-in job seeker with a job-search goal, one job tracked as drafted, Gmail connected with that employer's "application received" email, and "Every day" on.
steps: Open the Goals page after 9am
Wait for the check-in to finish, or click the check-in button
expected: Muse leaves a three-line progress brief and lists what needs the user's decision
The job with the confirmation email shows as applied
No email is sent during the check-in
Opening the page again the same day does not start a second check-in

testCases.title: App closed
testCases.given: A signed-in job seeker with a goal and "Every day" on, with the app closed all day.
steps: Keep the app closed past 9am
Open the Goals page the next morning before 9am
expected: No check-in ran while the app was closed
No new progress brief from that day is in the chat

testCases.title: Before 9am
testCases.given: A signed-in job seeker with a goal and "Every day" on, and no check-in yet today.
steps: Open the Goals page before 9am
Leave it open until after 9am
expected: No check-in runs before 9am
Exactly one check-in runs after 9am

journeys.title: Get answers from my own documents
journeys.goal: Ask questions and get answers grounded in my notes, with the source named.
journeys.trigger: The user uploads a document to the Library.

steps.action: Uploads a file; its text is extracted and stored
Asks Muse a question in chat
Searches and reads the Library (docs_search, docs_read)
Answers and names the document it used

journeys.outcome: An answer that cites which document it came from.

testCases.title: Answer cites the document
testCases.given: A signed-in user with an empty Library and a text file of meeting notes that mentions a launch date.
steps: Upload the notes file on the Library page
In chat, ask "When is the launch date in my notes?"
expected: The Library lists the document, titled after the file if no title was given
Muse's answer gives the launch date from the notes and names the document

testCases.title: File too large or unreadable
testCases.given: A signed-in user with a file over 3MB and a file with no readable text.
steps: Upload the file over 3MB
Upload the file with no readable text
expected: The first upload is refused with "file is too large (max 3MB)"
The second is refused with "no readable text could be extracted from this file"
Neither file appears in the Library

journeys.title: Email someone without leaving the chat
journeys.goal: Have Muse write and send an email to a contact, safely.
journeys.trigger: The user asks Muse to email someone.

steps.action: Asks Muse to email a person about something
Looks up the contact (contacts_lookup)
Shows an approval card with the recipient, subject and body
Sends the email after the user approves (mail_send)

journeys.outcome: The email is sent only with approval, and appears in the activity audit.
failures: The user declines or doesn't answer: nothing is sent and Muse says so.

testCases.title: Approved email is sent
testCases.given: A signed-in user with Gmail connected and a contact in their contacts.
steps: In chat, ask Muse to email that contact about rescheduling Friday's meeting
Read the approval card
Click Allow
expected: The card shows the recipient, subject and body
Nothing is sent before Allow is clicked
After Allow the email is sent and the send appears in the activity audit

testCases.title: Declined or unanswered
testCases.given: A signed-in user with Gmail connected and a contact in their contacts.
steps: Ask Muse to email that contact
Click Don't allow on the card, or leave it for 4 minutes
expected: No email is sent
Muse says it didn't send it
The decline or no answer appears in the activity audit

testCases.title: Unknown contact
testCases.given: A signed-in user with Gmail connected and no contact by the name they use.
steps: Ask Muse to email someone who isn't in contacts
Read Muse's reply
expected: Muse says it found no contact
No email is sent

journeys.title: Turn an idea into a goal
journeys.goal: Act on an idea Muse noticed in conversation.
journeys.trigger: Muse saves an idea while chatting.

steps.action: Saves an idea from the conversation (save_idea)
Chooses to turn the idea into a goal
Creates the goal linked to the idea (create_goal with idea_id)

journeys.outcome: The idea shows as a goal, and the goal has a plan.

testCases.title: Idea becomes a goal with a plan
testCases.given: A signed-in job seeker with no ideas and no goals.
steps: In chat, tell Muse "I should reach out to three former colleagues about PM openings"
Open the Ideas page
Click Make it a goal on that idea
expected: The idea appears on the Ideas page
A goal with 3 to 6 steps appears on the Goals page, linked to the idea
The idea shows under Acted on

testCases.title: Same idea twice
testCases.given: A signed-in user with that idea already on the Ideas page.
steps: Share the same idea in chat again
Open the Ideas page
expected: The idea appears only once

openQuestions: The daily check-in only starts while the app is open (it then runs on the server); is a server-side scheduler planned?
